decisions.statement: One value is written as one JSON object on one line.
A row's keys are written in the order the row has those keys.
Every line closes with a newline.
A property with no value is written as one file holding nothing.
A property's values are divided across the numbered files beside the page.
A division is made only where the values run past the ceiling handed in.
No file a division makes runs past that ceiling.
A ceiling is counted in bytes rather than in characters.
A line handed over already formed is divided as handed rather than made again.
One value running past the ceiling alone is refused rather than divided.
That refusal names the file the value was bound for.
The files are named in the order the values were handed over.
The values written here are read back by `page-entries` in the order written.
Nothing here reads or writes the disk.
Nothing here judges a value against the shape declaring that value.

definition: the files a page's entry values are written into
